走出机场时最容易手忙脚乱的，常常是“车到底在哪一层”和“下车后还有多远”。把机场: The most stressful questions after landing are often “Which level is my ride on?” and “How far will I still have to go after getting off?” Treat the trip from airport to home as its own itinerary: confirm someone can receive you at the destination, choose your transportation, and only then arrange the ride. Your pickup person should have the same plan.
第一步：把机场代码和当地日期写清楚: Step 1: specify the airport code and local arrival date
SFO 是旧金山国际机场，SJC 是圣何塞机场，OAK 是奥克兰机场。“旧金山附: SFO is San Francisco International Airport, SJC is San Jose's airport, and OAK is Oakland's airport. “An airport near San Francisco” isn't specific enough to arrange a pickup. For international flights, check the local Bay Area arrival date; don't use the departure location's date as the pickup date. After landing, immigration, baggage claim, and the walk to the pickup area still take time.
确认机场代码、航班号、当地抵达日期及航站楼；临时变更及时同步。: Confirm the airport code, flight number, local arrival date, and terminal. Share any last-minute changes promptly.
确认目的地的城市、入住或接待时间；详细门牌通过私下沟通提供。: Confirm your destination city and check-in or reception time. Share the exact street address privately.
列出人数、每件行李尺寸，以及轮椅、婴儿车或儿童座椅等需要提前确认的安排。: List the number of passengers, each bag's dimensions, and any arrangements to confirm in advance, such as wheelchairs, strollers, or child car seats.
保存接机方联系方式和机场交通页面，准备好落地后的联网方式。: Save your pickup contact and the airport transport page, and plan how to get online after landing.
三个机场，公共交通分别怎么接: How public transit connects at each airport
SFO：可以衔接 BART，航站楼之间可查看 AirTrain 指引。先在 SF: SFO: connect with BART, and check AirTrain directions for travel between terminals. Use SFO's ground transportation page to confirm the route to the station, then find a station near your destination. AirTrain and the BART train into the city are different services.
SJC：机场公共交通页面列有 VTA 60 路，可衔接 Santa Clara: SJC: the airport's public transit page lists VTA Route 60, connecting with hubs such as Santa Clara Transit Center and Milpitas BART. The direction you need depends on your final destination. Check the VTA route page for stops and temporary changes before leaving.
OAK：机场连接车先到 Coliseum，再转乘前往目的地的 BART 列车。请: OAK: take the airport connector to Coliseum, then transfer to a BART train toward your destination. Include the connector in your travel plan and check the full route on BART's OAK page.
比较的是“机场到门口”: Compare the entire trip from airport to doorstep
把步行、换乘、等车和车站到住处的最后一段一起比较。多人或大件行李出行时，座位与后: Include walking, transfers, waiting, and the last stretch from the station to your home. For groups or large bags, seating and trunk space may matter more than the fare alone. Have another option for flights arriving after public transit stops running.
约接送前，把报价拆成几个问题: Break the quote into a few questions before booking a ride
报价是否为这一趟的总价？停车、等待、过桥、深夜、多停靠点或大件行李是否另计？: Is the quote the total for this trip? Are parking, waiting, bridge tolls, late-night travel, extra stops, or large bags charged separately?
等待从航班落地、约定时间，还是走到上车区开始计算？延误和取消怎么处理？: Does waiting time start at landing, the agreed time, or arrival at the pickup area? How are delays and cancellations handled?
车型是否装得下实际人数与行李？特殊乘车需求是否已经明确确认？: Can the vehicle fit the actual number of passengers and bags? Have any special passenger needs been explicitly confirmed?
服务方是否能按机场要求接客？若提供收费运输，应核验适用于其实际服务的许可与保险，: Can the provider pick up passengers under the airport's rules? For paid transportation, check the permits and insurance that apply to the actual service. A platform profile badge does not replace those checks.
落地后再确认上车点，不在路边找“熟悉的出口”: Confirm the pickup point after landing—don't search the curb for a familiar exit
亲友接机、网约车、出租车可能使用不同区域；机场施工也会改变行走路线。先看机场现场: Friends and family, rideshare drivers, and taxis may use different pickup areas, and construction can change walking routes. Follow airport signs and official instructions for your transport choice, then tell your driver the terminal, level, and exit. Don't chase a car through traffic just because the driver says they're outside. SFO specifies that curbside pickup areas are for active loading and unloading; confirm waiting arrangements separately.
接送需求模板：填好之后再发送: Pickup request template: Complete it before sending
寻找机场接送： 机场：[SFO / SJC / OAK] 湾区当地日期与预计抵达:
Airport ride request:
Airport: [SFO / SJC / OAK]
Bay Area local date and expected arrival time: [date and time]
Destination city: [city; exact address shared privately]
Passengers: [number]; luggage: [number and dimensions]
Special arrangements: [child car seat, wheelchair, extra stops, etc.; write none if not needed]
Please specify: total quote and inclusions, waiting charges, delay/cancellation rules, and available vehicle type.
Flight details and the exact pickup point will be shared privately once confirmed.
出发前留一个能执行的备用方案: Have a workable backup before leaving
备用方案不用复杂：保存机场交通页、了解哪里能获得现场帮助，并确认住处是否允许晚到: A backup plan can be simple: save the airport transportation page, know where to get on-site help, and confirm whether your accommodation allows late arrival. If you miss your planned ride, update companions and the pickup contact before checking another route. Don't accept an unsolicited airport ride with unclear identity and pricing just to stay on schedule.
让接机沟通少来回几轮: Make airport pickup arrangements with fewer messages
按模板写清机场、日期、人数和行李，再发布需求。最终价格、接客资格与安排由双方核验: Use the template to specify the airport, date, passenger count, and luggage before posting. Both parties should verify the final price, pickup eligibility, and arrangements.
